descriptionText: Secrets should be referenced within dedicated environments to limit their scope and reduce the attack surface. When secrets are used outside of a defined environment, they may be repository-level or organization-level secrets that are available to all workflows and jobs. By defining an environment with required reviewers and environment-specific secrets, you can better control when and how sensitive credentials are used. Jobs without an environment that reference secrets (except GITHUB_TOKEN which is always available) should be reviewed to determine if they should use environment-scoped secrets instead.
